title: Arsenic in drinking water and congenital heart anomalies in Hungary.
authors: Rudnai T, Sándor J, Kádár M, Borsányi M, Béres J, Métneki J, Maráczi G, Rudnai P.
journal: International journal of hygiene and environmental health
quote: Regular consumption of drinking water with arsenic concentration above 10 μg/L during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of congenital heart anomalies in general (adjusted OR=1.41; 95% C.I.: 1.28-1.56), and especially that of ductus Botalli persistens (adjusted OR=1.81, 95%C.I.: 1.54-2.11) and atrial septal defect (adjusted OR=1.79; 95%C.I.: 1.59-2.01).
